meanings.usage: 指从事表演工作的女性，如电影、电视或戏剧演员
指为舞台表演创作的文学作品
指只覆盖脚部的短袜子
形容令人害怕或不舒服的情况
用于疑问句和否定句中
由orange和coloured组成的复合形容词

phrases.usage: 表示参加或参与某项活动、会议、比赛等

examples.en: Jennifer will have to take part in a new play soon.
examples.zh: 珍妮弗很快必须参加一个新剧本的演出。

phrases.usage: 表示尽管某种情况存在，通常后接名词或动名词

examples.en: In spite of this, she often appears on the stage as a young girl.
examples.zh: 尽管如此，她仍然经常在舞台上扮演年轻女孩。

phrases.usage: 表示最小数量或程度，意为'不少于'、'至少'

examples.en: She must be at least thirty-five years old.
examples.zh: 她一定有至少三十五岁了。

phrases.usage: 指在舞台上表演或亮相

examples.en: She often appears on the stage as a young girl.
examples.zh: 她经常在舞台上扮演年轻女孩。

phrases.phrase: It must be terrible to be...
phrases.usage: 用于表达对某种情况的主观感受，认为某事很糟糕

examples.en: Darling, it must be terrible to be grown up!
examples.zh: 亲爱的，长大成人一定很可怕！

examples.en: She had to wear short socks.

phrases.usage: 明亮的红色连衣裙，形容词+颜色构成复合形容词

examples.en: She must appear in a bright red dress.
examples.zh: 她必须穿一件鲜红色的连衣裙。

examples.en: She must wear long black stockings.
If anyone ever asks her how old she is, she always answers...
examples.zh: 如果有人问她多大了，她总是回答说...

phrases.usage: 十七岁的女孩，of+年龄表示年龄

examples.en: She will be a girl of seventeen.
examples.zh: 她将扮演一个十七岁的女孩。

phrases.usage: /teɪk pɑːt ɪn/ phrasal verb. 参加；参与（指参与某项活动或事件）
/ɪn spaɪt əv/ preposition phrase. 尽管；虽然（用于引出让步状语，与though/although同义）
/ət liːst/ phrase. 至少（表示最小数量或程度）

grammar.title: must be 表示推测
grammar.structure: 主语 + must be + 形容词/名词/数词
grammar.definition: must + 动词原形表示对现在情况非常有把握的推测，意为'一定是'、'肯定是' 用于根据证据或常识进行肯定推测，语气比might be、could be更强

examples.en: She must be at least thirty-five years old.
examples.zh: 她一定有至少三十五岁了。

examples.en: It must be terrible to be grown up!

grammar.title: will have to 表示将来必须
grammar.structure: 主语 + will have to + 动词原形
grammar.definition: will have to + 动词原形表示将来必须做某事，含有不可避免或计划中的意味 表示将来某个时间必须做的事情，比must更强调未来性

examples.en: Jennifer will have to take part in a new play soon.
examples.zh: 珍妮弗很快必须参加一个新剧本的演出。

grammar.title: if 引导的条件状语从句
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + 动词...，主语 + will/always + 动词...
grammar.definition: if 引导的条件状语从句表示假设情况，主句用一般现在时或will等 用于谈论可能发生的情况或习惯性的假设

examples.en: If anyone ever asks her how old she is, she always answers...
examples.zh: 如果有人问她多大了，她总是回答说...

patterns.pattern: 主语 + must be + 年龄/形容词

original.en: She must be at least thirty-five years old.
original.zh: 她一定有至少三十五岁了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + will have to + 动词原形

original.en: Jennifer will have to take part in a new play soon.
original.zh: 珍妮弗很快必须参加一个新剧本的演出。

imitations.en: I will have to leave early tomorrow.
We will have to finish this work today.
imitations.zh: 我们今天必须完成这项工作。

patterns.pattern: If + 条件句， 主语 + always + 动词

original.en: If anyone ever asks her how old she is, she always answers...
original.zh: 如果有人问她多大了，她总是回答说...

imitations.en: If it rains, I always stay at home.
imitations.zh: 如果下雨，我总是待在家里。

imitations.en: If he calls, I always answer the phone.
imitations.zh: 如果他打电话，我总是接电话。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + must + 动词原形 + in + 服装

original.en: She must appear in a bright red dress and long black stockings.
original.zh: 她必须穿一件鲜红色连衣裙和黑色长筒袜出场。

imitations.en: He must come in a black suit.
She must appear in a white dress.
imitations.zh: 她必须穿白色连衣裙出场。

lines.en: My aunt Jennifer is an actress. She must be at least thirty-five years old.
lines.zh: 我的姑姑詹妮弗是位演员，她至少也有35岁了。

lines.en: In spite of this, she often appears on the stage as a young girl.
lines.zh: 尽管如此，她却常在舞台上扮演小姑娘。

lines.en: Jennifer will have to take part in a new play soon.
lines.zh: 詹妮弗很快又要参加一个新剧的演出。

lines.en: This time, she will be a girl of seventeen.
lines.zh: 这一次，她将扮演一个17岁的少女。

lines.en: In the play, she must appear in a bright red dress and long black stockings .
lines.zh: 演出时她必须穿一条鲜红色的裙子和黑色的长筒袜。

lines.en: Last year in another play, she had to wear short socks and a bright, orange-coloured dress.
lines.zh: 去年在演另一个剧时，她不得不穿短袜和一件鲜艳的橘红色的衣服。

lines.en: If anyone ever asks her how old she is, she always answers, 'Darling, it must be terrible to be grown up!'
lines.zh: 一旦有人问起她有多大年纪，她总是回答：“亲爱的，长成大人真可怕啊！”

questions.q: Why doesn't Aunt Jennifer tell anyone how old she is?
questions.zh: 为什么詹妮弗姑姑不告诉任何人她的年龄？
questions.a: Because she is at least thirty-five but likes to appear as a young girl; she thinks it must be terrible to be grown up.
questions.aZh: 因为她至少已三十五岁，却总在舞台上扮演少女，觉得“长成大人真可怕”，所以总是回避这个问题。
questions.hint: 答案出自课文末句 she always answers, 'Darling, it must be terrible to be grown up!'，并结合首句 She must be at least thirty-five years old。

questions.q: What must Jennifer wear in the new play?
questions.zh: 詹妮弗在新剧里必须穿什么？
questions.a: She must appear in a bright red dress and long black stockings.
questions.aZh: 她必须穿一条鲜红色的裙子和黑色的长筒袜登台。
questions.hint: 见课文第五句 In the play, she must appear in a bright red dress and long black stockings。

questions.q: What is the difference between her costume this time and last year's?
questions.zh: 她这次的戏服和去年的有什么不同？
questions.a: Last year she had to wear short socks and a bright, orange-coloured dress, but this time she will wear long black stockings and a bright red dress.
questions.aZh: 去年她不得不穿短袜和鲜艳的橘红色衣服，这次则要穿黑色长筒袜和鲜红色裙子。
questions.hint: 对比课文第五句与第六句：this time 与 Last year in another play 的服装描写。

questions.q: How old is Jennifer, and how old is the girl she will play?
questions.zh: 詹妮弗实际多少岁？她要扮演的少女多少岁？
questions.a: She must be at least thirty-five years old, and this time she will be a girl of seventeen.
questions.aZh: 她至少有三十五岁，而这次要扮演一个十七岁的少女。
questions.hint: 见课文首句 She must be at least thirty-five years old 与第四句 This time, she will be a girl of seventeen。

questions.q: Why does the writer use 'In spite of this' instead of 'So' at the beginning of the second sentence?
questions.zh: 作者为什么在第二句开头用 in spite of this（尽管如此），而不用 so（所以）？
questions.a: Because her appearing as a young girl contrasts with her real age: she is at least thirty-five, yet she still plays teenagers. 'In spite of this' expresses concession, while 'So' would wrongly suggest a cause-and-effect relation.
questions.aZh: 因为“扮演少女”与“至少三十五岁”之间是让步转折而非因果：尽管年纪不小，她仍演少女。用 in spite of this 突出反差，用 so 会把转折误写成因果。
questions.hint: 结合第二句 In spite of this, she often appears on the stage as a young girl 与首句的年龄信息。

translation:
我的姑姑詹妮弗是位演员，她至少也有35岁了。
尽管如此，她却常在舞台上扮演小姑娘。
詹妮弗很快又要参加一个新剧的演出。
这一次，她将扮演一个17岁的少女。
演出时她必须穿一条鲜红色的裙子和黑色的长筒袜。
去年在演另一个剧时，她不得不穿短袜和一件鲜艳的橘红色的衣服。
一旦有人问起她有多大年纪，她总是回答：“亲爱的，长成大人真可怕啊！”
title: Always young
subtitle: 青春常驻

lead.question: 至少三十五岁的詹妮弗，为什么总在舞台上扮演十几岁的少女？
lead.warmup: 本课讲一位“不愿长大”的女演员。她至少三十五岁，却常常以少女形象出现在舞台上；新戏里要穿鲜红裙子和黑色长筒袜，去年演另一出戏时穿的却是短袜和橘红色连衣裙。有人问她的年龄，她总用一句玩笑话岔开。读的过程中请留意：作者如何用 must be、have to 表达“推测”与“客观要求”，又如何用 in spite of、as 把反差写得格外生动。
goals: 掌握 appear、stage、bright、stocking、sock 等本课核心词汇的词义与搭配
区分 must be 表肯定推测与 must / have to 表客观要求的用法差异
学会 in spite of、at least、take part in、grow up 等短语的准确使用
能用 as + 原级 + as 同级比较结构改写、仿写本课句子
lead.summary: 全文围绕“年龄与角色”的反差展开：先点明詹妮弗的真实年龄至少三十五岁，再用 In spite of this 转折，说她常以少女形象登台；接着交代即将参演的新戏和十七岁少女的角色，并详细描述两次演出的服装——这次是鲜红长裙配黑色长筒袜，去年是短袜配橘红色连衣裙。最后用她那句“长成大人真可怕”收尾，把一位怕老又爱演的演员写得活灵活现。
lead.tips: 易错点：stocking 是长筒袜，sock 是短袜，别混；on the stage 指“在舞台上登台”，in the stage 属搭配错误。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我的姑姑詹妮弗是位演员，她至少也有三十五岁了。
exercises.a: My aunt Jennifer is an actress. She must be at least thirty-five years old.
exercises.note: must be 表肯定推测，at least 置于数词前。

exercises.q: 句型转换：Although she is at least thirty-five, she often appears on the stage as a young girl.（用 in spite of 改写）
exercises.a: In spite of this, she often appears on the stage as a young girl.
exercises.note: in spite of 后接名词或 this，不接句子。

exercises.q: 用所给词翻译：詹妮弗很快又要参加一个新剧的演出。（take part in）
exercises.a: Jennifer will have to take part in a new play soon.
exercises.note: have to 表客观要求，参加演出用 take part in a play。

exercises.q: 填空：Last year she had to wear short ______ (sock) and a bright, ______ (orange-colour) dress.
exercises.note: sock 短袜须用复数；复合形容词加 -ed。

exercises.q: 改错：In the play, she must appears in a bright red dress and long black stocking.
exercises.a: In the play, she must appear in a bright red dress and long black stockings.
exercises.note: must 后接动词原形；stocking 此处用复数。

exercises.q: 汉译英：亲爱的，长成大人真可怕啊！
exercises.a: Darling, it must be terrible to be grown up!
exercises.note: grown up 作形容词表“成年的”，it 为形式主语。

exercises.q: 句型转换：She is not as young as the girl she plays this time.（用 as … as 原级结构补充说明）
exercises.a: She is not as young as the girl she will play this time.
exercises.note: as + 形容词原级 + as，否定用 not as … as。

quiz.q: “她至少也有三十五岁了”，课文原句是哪一句？
options: She must be at least thirty-five years old.
She has to be thirty-five years old at least.
She is thirty-five years old at the least.
She can be at least thirty-five years old.
quiz.note: must be 表肯定推测，at least 置于数词前。

quiz.q: 下列哪个短语表示“尽管如此、虽然如此”？
options: in case of
in front of
in spite of
instead of
quiz.note: in spite of 表让步；instead of 表“而不是”。

quiz.q: 詹妮弗在新剧中的服装是哪一套？
options: short socks and a bright, orange-coloured dress
a bright red dress and long black stockings
long black stockings and a bright orange skirt
short socks and a bright red dress
quiz.note: 橘红色短袜那套是去年另一出戏的服装。

quiz.q: “詹妮弗很快又要参加一个新剧的演出”，哪一项表达正确？
options: Jennifer will have to join a new play soon.
Jennifer will have to take part in a new play soon.
Jennifer will have to take part a new play soon.
Jennifer will has to take part in a new play soon.
quiz.note: take part in 后接宾语，will 后接原形 have to。

quiz.q: 英语里表示“长筒袜”的词是？
options: sock
stocking
stoking
shock
quiz.note: sock 是短袜，stocking 才是长筒袜。

quiz.q: 有人问詹妮弗年龄时，她总是怎么回答？
options: Darling, I am only seventeen!
Darling, it must be terrible to be grown up!
Darling, I am at least thirty-five!
Darling, I have to act a young girl!
quiz.note: 课文末句原话，用玩笑避开真实年龄。
